status: Post hoc re-analysis (roadmap Steps 6 and 6b), written on 2026-11-08 after every v1 and v2 result had been seen. Its families and rules are labelled a re-analysis, not a pre-registered test; v3's own pre-registration is SPEC_V3.md.
seed_note: seed_transpiler is the first v2 base seed. The sweep reruns each Qiskit default level with ten other seeds to show whether the choice depends on the seed; it is context, not a result.

v1-headline.description: v1 score vs naive placement under real converted noise (N2, base variant): the 11 headline cases of REPORT.md section 1

v2-headline.description: decoder-graph score vs naive placement, lowest summed error, Qiskit's default transpile (level 1) and mapomatic, on all 10 v2 cases

test: two-sided pooled two-proportion z-test on the pooled failure counts; a comparison of a placement with itself has p = 1

bootstrap.description: Retained-gain intervals: percentile bootstrap resampling draws and redrawing every placement's pooled failure count from Binomial(shots, P_L), as v2's M6; one stream per (case, method, delta) from sha256('reanalysis-m6|<seed>|<case>|<method>|<delta>')
